[[Company Brain]] › Reference › Discord commands

All slash commands from [[Company Brain/awdiscord|awdiscord]], grouped by where they come from. In a real wiki this table would live in '''one place''' and be transcluded into the guide, the brick page and the plugin page, so it can never drift.

<span id="core"></span>
== Core ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Command
! What it does
! Who
|-
| <code>/ask question [persona] [private]</code>
| The agent answers; <code>private</code> shows only you
| anyone
|-
| <code>/share</code>
| Posts your last answer in the channel
| anyone
|-
| <code>/status</code>
| Is the agent up, which personas exist
| anyone
|-
| <code>/model setup\|test\|status\|off</code>
| Run this server on its own endpoint ([[Company Brain/Bring your own model|details]])
| Manage Server
|-
| <code>/selfhost</code>
| Wizard from no model to this server’s own endpoint
| Manage Server
|-
| <code>/plugins list\|info\|enable\|disable</code>
| What this server has on
| enable/disable: Manage Server
|}

<span id="voice"></span>
== Voice ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Command
! What it does
|-
| <code>/join</code>, <code>/leave</code>
| Move the bot in and out of a voice channel
|-
| <code>/calls mode:on</code>
| Turn on self-running calls for this server (bot owner)
|-
| <code>/calls</code>
| See what is on (answered privately)
|}

Spoken: “Aither, take notes” · “Aither, off the record” · “Aither, back on the record” · “Aither, stop” · “Aither, create a task to …”
